what_this_is: architecture/specification freeze of the B3 choice-evidence stage
what_this_is_not: a publication run or a final benchmark result (all numbers are DEVELOPMENT evidence: 396 learner-facing items, 329 + 189 Answers, v4 offline replay)
an adoption of any template into the production registry (predicate_policy_v2.json unchanged)

units.B_pre: optional OPTIONAL_CONTEXT clue groups in S_pre (mandatory R* groups and the CLASS frame are outside the count)
units.B_post: unique right-side ENTITY nodes of S_post (mandatory R* nodes count once; a node shared by several groups counts once; the CLASS node never counts)
units.K_A: optional groups with support exactly {A}; R* groups are exempt by definition

pre: C-PRE-1 every R* group selected with full support
C-PRE-4 N1: |N_mand| + sum y_o <= B_post with COVER_ALT witnesses w_h (y_o >= z_g, y_o >= w_h; sum_{h in ALT(d)} w_h >= 1)
post: C-POST-2 |N_mand| + sum y_o <= B_post, two-sided y/z linking
C-POST-3 COVER_ALT for every distractor with a showable alternative
C-POST-5 nesting P subset of Q

post_admissible_set: all OPTIONAL_CONTEXT groups of the universe + all showable RATIONALE_ALTERNATIVE groups + the pre-selected groups (ABSENCE_ONLY, containment, unresolved, risk-bearing, distractor-label-leaking and template-less groups admissible post-answer, ordered against and counted; EXCLUDED never)
tie_break: sequential exact minimisation with equality rows per level; then the lexicographically largest 0/1 vector over free groups in canonical order (block-wise powers of two permitted, block size recorded)

solver_protocol.publication_rule: OPTIMAL at every level + pure-Python re-check for every published item; otherwise CE_SOLVER_NOT_OPTIMAL_<status> / CE_RECHECK_FAILED, item not published, count in manifest, non-zero exit; no greedy fallback
solver_protocol.n1_recheck: |N_mand ∪ nodes(P) ∪ W| <= B_post with the returned witness set W; the audit's development-only slack (+3) is forbidden in production
solver_protocol.oracle: exhaustive enumeration for <= 16 free groups must agree

fallback_bounding.touches: OPTIONAL_CONTEXT only; never answerability, alternatives or grounding

template_policy.phase_2_target: the remaining 43 SAFE_TO_TEMPLATE keys of template_candidates_v1.json
template_policy.rule_on_version_change: new versioned registry file; every verbalizability-affected upstream/downstream measurement rerun before publication; frozen development artefacts never rewritten

pre_answer: one sentence per group of S_pre with every supporting letter (atomicity)
R* in positive Answer-attribute phrasing, no exclusivity marker (P1)
Who is A? + four names in the recorded printed order

post_answer_graph.right: ENTITY nodes of S_post (<= 7) + one CLASS node (typed, provenance-marked, budget-exempt)
post_answer_graph.edges: one per observed fact edge of every selected group; OUT drawn choice->node, IN drawn node->choice; roles MANDATORY_RATIONALE / RATIONALE_ALTERNATIVE / OPTIONAL_CONTEXT / CLASS_FRAME
forbidden: containment drawn as a choice-node edge
post_answer_graph.legend: an edge is a fact recorded in the pinned snapshot; a missing edge means the snapshot records nothing, not that the fact is false

presentation.explanation_prose: template-based; per distractor cites only basis(d) (R* facts at >= L1) and the drawn observed alternative; no L0 fact cited; no forbidden phrasing; no LLM polish in the benchmark

invariants.I-15: no human-difficulty inference from structural metrics
invariants.I-19: every drawn edge observed in K
invariants.I-24: UNIVERSE_FULL unless the declared guard fired
